question.text: Books of accounts of a Category III AIF must be audited:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 3.3.1.2, books of accounts must be audited annually by a qualified auditor. The Trap: On-demand/5-yearly/never audits are non-compliant. Cross-Exam Context: Same annual audit for Cat I/II (XIX-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maintain audit-ready files quarterly so year-end audit is efficient.
